column3: Rank1 was an awkward "chose to choose" sentence and all 5 rows reused the bare form "choose"; rewrote rank1 and added chose/chooses/chosen for verb form variety.

All 5 rows correctly use the "large settlement" sense with a vivid rank1.
All 5 rows depicted a school lesson but were pointed at sense 30718 (generic category); re-pointed sense_id to 30722 (group of students in a scheduled lesson).

All 5 rows used only the bare verb form "climb" with no tense variety; added the noun sense (an act of climbing) and climbed/climbing forms.
